text.content:
Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.GOMS6bxDEdEkKyTo]{18. The Linnorm's Pass}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.16ANQRIvEQBQGIvY]{Vashkra}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.UPfDMH5xrS5v1PH9]{Fallen Pitaxian Soldier}

Zone Zone 19: Branthlend Mountains (a high pass with an avalanche chute and a lava vent)
Hex 3.0 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Role-play (bargain); combat at party level 18 or later
Threat Bargain at any level. Fight: beyond Extreme at 16, Severe 120 at party level 18, Moderate 80 at party level 19.
Creatures Tor linnorm (L21, Monster Core)

Irovetti's map note. A dashed line labelled "trade road west" stops dead at a coiled serpent drawn in red ink. The note reads: "blocked — serpent. Sent 40 men. Sent 12 more. No."

Background. The tor linnorm Vashkra has lain in this pass for four centuries. She sleeps on a magma vent that keeps her coils warm, and she counts the pass as part of her body. Irovetti wanted a western trade route over the Branthlends and sent soldiers twice; their bones line the chute. Vashkra wants two things: a tribute worthy of her age, and news of the world beyond the mountains, which she has not left in a century. Linnorms curse their killers, and Vashkra knows it. She enjoys reminding anyone who threatens her.

Arrival.

Steam rolls down the pass from a crack in the mountainside where orange light pulses like a heartbeat. The bones of soldiers in Pitaxian green lie in drifts against the rocks. Then the mountain moves: a coil of grey-scaled serpent the width of a tower lifts from the scree, and a head crowned with horns of obsidian rises to look down at you. "More of Irovetti's children?" it asks, in a voice like a rockslide. "No. You smell of a different crown."

Features.

  • The chute. A 200-foot avalanche chute runs down the pass. Loud noise or area damage of 40 or more there triggers a rockslide (DC 40 Reflex, 10d10 bludgeoning, buried on a critical failure).
  • The magma vent. A 30-foot-wide fissure of molten rock. Creatures that end a turn within 10 feet take 6d6 fire damage. Vashkra swims in it freely.
  • Soldiers' bones. Fifty-two Pitaxian soldiers lie here. Searching them yields their regimental insignia and Irovetti's original orders, both useful as evidence of Pitaxian aggression.
  • Narrow ledges. The pass narrows to 15 feet in two places. Gargantuan Vashkra can't enter these without squeezing.

Running the encounter. Vashkra opens with conversation. She knows the PCs did not come from Pitax and is curious. Run an Influence encounter over 5 rounds. She has no patience for threats, and the curse makes any fight costly even if the PCs win.

Vashkra the tor linnorm (Influence)

  • Perception DC 42
  • Discovery DC 40 Nature or Arcana; DC 42 Society
  • Influence Skills DC 42 Diplomacy, DC 44 Deception, DC 47 Intimidation, DC 40 Performance (she loves sagas of battle), DC 38 Lore about the River Kingdoms or Brevoy (news of the world)
  • Influence 2: Vashkra agrees to let the PCs themselves pass.
  • Influence 4: Vashkra names her tribute: a magic item of level 17 or higher, or an equivalent hoard (12,000 gp in metals and gems), delivered every year on midwinter. In return she lets caravans bearing the PCs' banner use the pass.
  • Influence 6: Vashkra accepts a smaller tribute (6,000 gp per year) and promises to burn any Pitaxian or Wild Hunt force that enters the pass. She tells the PCs that "riders without tracks" have tested her pass twice this season.
  • Resistances Mentions of Irovetti or Pitax (+2 DC to all checks that round). Any threat to kill her (+5 DC Intimidation; she reminds them of the curse).
  • Weaknesses Tales of great battles, especially the PCs' own war against Pitax (–2 DC Performance). Offering tribute up front (–2 DC Diplomacy).
  • Penalty Two critical failures provoke her: she uses Pyroclastic Breath once as a warning and gives the PCs one more round to leave.

Combat. At party level 18 or higher, the PCs may choose to fight. Vashkra opens with Pyroclastic Breath, then uses Slashing Claws against multiple targets. She retreats into the magma vent to regenerate, which forces PCs to fight her near the fire. She keeps up Regeneration 20 until cold iron hits her. Whoever lands the killing blow must save against the Curse of Boiling Blood (DC 48 Will).

Outcomes.

  • Bargain. The pass opens as a trade route. The kingdom gains a new Trade route between its Western holdings and the Branthlends: +1 to Trade Agreements checks while the tribute is paid.
  • Vashkra slain. The pass opens permanently. The killer carries the curse until a 9th-rank cleanse affliction or an equivalent ritual removes it.
  • PCs leave. Vashkra remains. The PCs may return with tribute.

Rewards. 120 XP for any resolution at Influence 4 or more, or for a victory at party level 18. Treasure: the soldiers' gear yields 800 gp. Vashkra's hoard, reached through the magma vent (fire resistance or a DC 40 Athletics check to swim through it), holds 9,000 gp in obsidian, silver and gems, plus a level 18 permanent item.

Scaling. At party level 19, add two magma elemental servants or raise the curse DC by 2. For a gentler table, Vashkra lets any party that reaches Influence 2 pass with no tribute.
